name: Kozukuri Renshuu Jugyou - Love's Right - Sex Shinai to Sokushikei
original_name: 子作り練習授業 Love's Right セックスしないと即死刑
source: Popuri is a 5th grade elementary school teacher who decides it's time to teach her class of girls about sex and what better way than with a live demonstration? So she brings in a young man to have sex with the class president, 10 year old Takeshiba Merumo in order to teach her class everything there is to know about sex and if he refuses, he'll be given the death penalty!
translation: 波普里是一名五年级小学老师，她决定是时候向班上的女孩们传授性知识了，还有什么比现场演示更好的方法呢？于是，她请来一名年轻人与班长、10岁的竹柴梅鲁毛发生性关系，以便向全班传授有关性的一切知识，如果他拒绝，就会被判处死刑！
